{"metadata":{"description":"Markdown rendering for DeepSeek Harness sent messages: the user and steering chat bubbles render headings, lists, code, tables, math and quotes through the host's own Markdown pipeline, while reference chips, attachments and the action strip stay intact.","id":"gh:1398389832","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-markdown-bubble","slug":"DDDMUC/dsh-markdown-bubble","topics":["chat","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","markdown","render"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Markdown rendering for DeepSeek Harness sent messages: the user and steering chat bubbles render hea"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dings, lists, code, tables, math and quotes through the host's own Markdown pipeline, while referenc"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"e chips, attachments and the action strip stay intact."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-markdown-bubble"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**DeepSeek Harness 用户消息 Markdown 渲染插件 —— 你发出去的每一条消息，都按 Markdown 渲染。** 标题、列表、加粗、行内代码、引用、代码块、表格与公式不再以源"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"码形态躺在气泡里，而是经宿主自己的 Markdown 管线（`MarkdownText`）呈现；引用 chip、附件、时间/复制操作条与其它插件注入的按钮全部原样保留。实现方式是官方 keyed 槽位"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" `conversation.chat.node` 的 `user` / `steering` 座位替换，不修改 DSH 源码，不改写任何会话日志。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 · English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"### 特性"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **官方座位替换** —— 经 `ctx.slots` 在 `conversation.chat.node` 的 `user` / `steering` 两个 keyed 座位上以 `priori"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ty: -1` 遮蔽宿主渲染器；停用/卸载即恢复宿主自己的气泡，不改源码、不动日志
- **宿主同款渲染** —— 不自己造 Markdown 管线，直接调用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cl"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ient-ui-primitives` 的 `MarkdownText`：与助手回复同一套解析、高亮、表格、公式与代码卡
- **引用 chip 保留** —— 调用宿主自己的文本工厂槽 `conve"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"rsation.user.text`（0.2.1 起投影就住在那里），返回的片段按 chip / 纯文本拆分：chip 仍是可点击的文件 / 技能 chip，纯文本段逐个进 Markdown
- **"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"操作条与三方插件兼容** —— 时间 + 复制按钮用官方 primitives 重建，操作条保留 `_actions` / `_action` 类名后缀与 `data-clock` 锚点；dsh-ed"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"it-turn、dsh-delete-turn、dsh-rerun-turn 的按钮注入照常工作
- **附件与补充块** —— 图片走官方的图片画廊工厂槽 `conversation.images."},{"id":"p6s7","text":"content`，文件卡、引用摘要、`JsonBlock` 补充块与宿主同款
- **软换行保留** —— 仅对围栏代码之外的续行补 GFM 两空格硬换行；代码块一个字节不动，缩进代码与表格行不误伤
"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"- **出错兜底** —— 单条消息的渲染错误被错误边界接住，回退为宿主的原始投影，不会连累整条座位被槽位机制摘除
- **中英双语** 随系统语言切换（代码卡文案复用宿主 `chat` 字典）"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 已知限制"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **待确认气泡不覆盖**：本地回声与待发送 steering 由宿主 `PendingSubmissionBubble` / `PendingSteeringBubble` 直绘，不走 chat-"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"node 座位，仍是纯文本；消息落盘后即切换为 Markdown。
- **队列预览不覆盖**：排队消息的一行预览与 goal 命令行保持纯文本。
- **行内 chip 的折衷**：chip 打断连"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"排段落时，该段会拆成 chip 两边的块（与社区同类实现相同的取舍）；chip 在段首/段尾的常见情形无缝。
- **皮肤边界**：若某个皮肤直接针对宿主 CSS-module 类名定制用户气泡样式，"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"不会命中本插件的气泡；主题 token 与 `.dshmb-*` / `.dshmb_*` 自定义样式正常生效。
- **多行语义**：单换行按硬换行渲染；连续空格、Tab 缩进等 Markdown "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"n 与 `.dshmb-*` / `.dshmb_*` 自定义样式正常生效。
- **多行语义**：单换行按硬换行渲染；连续空格、Tab 缩进等 Markdown 忽略的空白会被折叠（代码块内除外）。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 兼容性"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- 实测 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（web profile，Chromium）。依赖：keyed 槽位 `conversation.chat.node`（`user` / `steering`"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"）、座位上的 `renderFactorySlot` 绑定、行锚点 `data-chat-flow-kind` / `data-pending-steering` / `data-submission"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"-echo`、primitives 导出的 `MarkdownText` / `writeClipboard`。
- **0.2.1 把扩展点往里挪了**，本插件 0.1.5 已按新契约移植（旧契约的"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"三样东西都不在了）：`primitives.projectUserText` 被删除 → 改调文本工厂槽 `conversation.user.text`；座位 props 从 `{ node, re"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"nderMessageImages, openFile, openSkill, t }` 变成 `{ node, renderFactorySlot, loadImage, t }` → 图片改调图片"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"画廊工厂槽 `conversation.images.content`。
- **为什么不能去换内容工厂槽**：`conversation.chat.user.content` 由宿主注册，插件再注册"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"同名工厂会让**宿主自己的聊天插件启动失败**（实测 `web boot: 1 entry did not activate @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat: fail"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ed`），所以「只换气泡内部」这条路走不通；同理，`conversation.chat.user.images` 这个子槽也不能由插件声明（实测 `slot "conversation.chat.us"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"er.images" is already declared (by factory "conversation.chat.user.content")`）。座位替换 + 两个工厂槽调用是当前版本唯一"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"可行且不伤宿主的组合。
- 与 `dsh-edit-turn`、`dsh-delete-turn`、`dsh-rerun-turn` 协同：三者的按钮注入基于 `[class*="_actions"]"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"` / `[class*="_action"]`，本插件保留该契约；被 dsh-edit-turn 改写（rollback）的消息显示其自己的改写气泡，与本插件无关。
- 宿主半区为惰性入口（无运行时"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"行为），全部逻辑在 `./client` 浏览器半区；不修改官方源码，不写私有事件类型。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Why you need it"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Known limitations"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Pending bubbles are not covered**: the local submission echo and the pending steering bubble are"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" drawn directly by the host (not through the chat-node seats) and stay plain text until the message "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"lands.
- **Queue previews are not covered**: the one-line queue preview and goal command rows stay p"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"lain text.
- **Inline-chip trade-off**: a chip interrupting a running paragraph splits that paragrap"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"h into blocks around the chip (the same trade-off community implementations take); boundary chips ar"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"e seamless.
- **Skin boundary**: a skin that styles the host's CSS-module bubble classes directly wi"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ll not hit this plugin's bubble; theme tokens and `.dshmb-*` / `.dshmb_*` custom styles work.
- **Mu"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"lti-line semantics**: single newlines render as hard breaks; whitespace Markdown ignores (runs of sp"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"aces, tab indentation) is collapsed outside code blocks."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Compatibility"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` (web profile, Chromium). Depends on the keyed `conversation.chat"},{"id":"p16s2","text":".node` slot, the `data-chat-flow-kind` / `data-pending-steering` / `data-submission-echo` row anchor"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"s, and the primitives exports `MarkdownText` / `projectUserText` / `writeClipboard`.
- Works alongsi"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"de `dsh-edit-turn`, `dsh-delete-turn` and `dsh-rerun-turn`: their injection relies on `[class*="_act"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ions"]` / `[class*="_action"]`, which this plugin preserves. A message rewritten (rolled back) by ds"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"h-edit-turn shows that plugin's own replacement bubble, which is out of scope here.
- The host half "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"is an inert entry (no runtime behavior); everything lives in the `./client` browser bundle. No offic"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ial source is modified and no private event type is written."}],"truncated":true}
